spec.title: Does routing change with the elevation source?
spec.question: On identical 72×72 grids, how similar are elevation, D8 directions and flow concentration from Terrarium tiles versus USGS 3DEP bare earth?
metrics: share of cells with identical receiver
limitations: Both sources derive partly from USGS elevation data; agreement is not independent confirmation.
3DEP is resampled by the server and Terrarium by the app; part of the difference is resampling.

inputs.source: NYC Borough Boundaries (shoreline-clipped), NYC Department of City Planning
Mapzen Terrarium tiles (AWS Terrain Tiles) and USGS 3DEP Bare Earth dynamic ImageServer
